paragraphs.text: The art for the Gift Bundle 's packaging is taken from the 1985 Marvel Age Annual . As the art is reused, several characters present do not appear in set.
paragraphs.section: Marketing

paragraphs.text: Five cards in Marvel Super Heroes create legendary tokens, the most of any set.
paragraphs.section: Set

paragraphs.text: No version of the Black Panther is actually black .
paragraphs.section: Set

paragraphs.text: This is the first Standard-legal set to feature mono - blue creatures with reach .
paragraphs.section: Set

paragraphs.text: Fantastic Four Vol. 3 #64 depicts Reed and Franklin Richards playing Magic , making them the first characters depicted on Magic cards to have canonically played the game themselves.
paragraphs.section: Set

paragraphs.text: Several notable characters and teams traditionally associated with the sphere of canon Marvel Super Heroes covers are mostly unrepresented in the set, including: All Asgardians other than Thor and Loki Jim Hammond, the first Human Torch The Mandarin The Red Skull Jolt is the only member of the original Thunderbolts not to appear in any form across all set products. Doctor Strange makes small appearances in the art of a few cards in the set (e.g., We Say Thee Nay! ). However, he only received a single card of his own as part of the associated Jumpstart product ( Doctor Strange, Surgeon ). This card depicts him during his time as a surgeon, before he had any mystical powers. Other unseeen characters associated with the mystical side of Marvel include Blade , Ghost_Rider , and Moon_Knight , although the latter appears in the art of Borough Backup .
paragraphs.section: Set

paragraphs.text: There are no common Legendary creatures, in contrast to Marvel's Spider-Man , but several common creatures are given generic names that still point to one particular character, usually marked by a quote. Examples are Stark Industries Executive ( Pepper Potts ), Powerful Broker ( The Power Broker ), and Brave Brawler ( Demolition Man ).
paragraphs.section: Set

paragraphs.text: Although the set generally focuses on the canon of the main Marvel Comics universe, rather than the Marvel Cinematic Universe, Agent Phil Coulson is a notable exception. The card reflects his original MCU characterization as a fan and supporter of superheroes, whereas after his introduction into the comics, Phil Coulson became an antagonist who fanatically hates superheroes, and an avatar of the Death Stone.
paragraphs.section: Cards

paragraphs.text: Captain America, Team Leader , like Captain America, First Avenger , uses a non-standard ordering for the mana symbols in its casting cost, listing red , white , and blue (as in the Flag of the United States ) instead of the standard ordering of blue, red, white as seen on Director Nick Fury .
paragraphs.section: Cards

paragraphs.text: The four uncommon cards representing the Fantastic Four — Invisible Woman, Sue Storm ; Mister Fantastic, Reed Richards ; Human Torch, Johnny Storm ; and The Thing, Ben Grimm —together form an infinite loop with their triggered abilities that will win the game.
paragraphs.section: Cards

paragraphs.text: Hellcat, Undying Vigilante 's second ability is similar to undying . Patsy Walker has indeed returned from death exactly once in her publication history.
paragraphs.section: Cards

paragraphs.text: Normally, static abilities are listed first in a card's text box, followed by triggered abilities and activated abilities . However, M.O.D.O.K. has its activated ability listed before its non-keyworded static ability. This is so that the flavor words associated with the two abilities appear in the same order that they do in the acronym of MODOK 's name.
paragraphs.section: Cards

paragraphs.text: An official Magic: The Gathering social media post made shortly before the set's release advertised the two-card infinite combo between The Incredible Hulk and Caltrops , which players had identified shortly after the former was spoiled months earlier. This is despite the fact that, at the time this post was made, Caltrops had not been reprinted since Seventh Edition (released over 25 years prior).
paragraphs.section: Cards

paragraphs.text: Agent of Atlas , Kree Commandos and Monica Rambeau are the first new mono- white creatures with prowess since the keyword was introduced in Tarkir block .
paragraphs.section: Cards

paragraphs.text: Pet Avengers has the most printed creature types of any card.
paragraphs.section: Cards
